stack_arguments.observed_use: Compares against the current slot, increments rhs+0x08 when non-null, and publishes rhs to the slot.

abi.return_evidence: The function ends with RET 0x4 on both normal and equality paths.

layout.owner: The concrete Texture owner is unresolved and remains an opaque prefix.

mechanics.equality_noop: If the incoming rhs equals the current slot value, return without changing either refcount.
mechanics.rhs_acquire: If rhs is non-null after the equality check, atomically increment the 32-bit word at rhs+0x08.
mechanics.slot_publication: Store rhs into the receiver slot at offset 0x00 before releasing the old value.
mechanics.old_release: If old is non-null, atomically decrement the 32-bit word at old+0x08.
mechanics.below_one_clamp: Read the post-decrement refcount; if it is below one, atomically add one and return without deleting the texture.
mechanics.no_delete: The target has no delete, destructor, or concrete Texture destruction call.
mechanics.concurrency_boundary: The model uses locked atomic read-modify-write operations, but concrete synchronization and object-lifetime guarantees remain opaque.
mechanics.operation_trace: The focused model test records rhs acquire, slot store, old release, and clamp in the reconstructed sequence without changing production source; distinct replacement asserts acquire, store, release, clamp and equality asserts an empty trace.

The 33-instruction body preserves ECX as the receiver, ESP+0x04 as rhs, locked XADD operations, the +0x08 refcount offset, the equality branch, and RET 0x4.
